description: Instituto Superior Técnico and INESC-ID publish Águeda.2016Flood, observations and model outputs describing a February 2016 flood in the Portuguese Águeda River. The collection brings together topo-bathymetric, land-use and hydrometric information with numerically produced hydrometric data from a calibrated shallow-water model. HydroShare identifies geographic-raster and individual-file content, with temporal coverage from 8 to 16 February 2016. The published resource is openly available and free under CC-BY-4.0. Internal file encodings and sampling intervals were not checked in the archive. A limitation is that simulated values compensate for missing observations near the city, so the collection mixes measured and reconstructed evidence. It can support reproducible testing of river-flood simulations and comparison of infrastructure exposure estimates. The dataset complements the associated RiverCure public context by preserving reusable inputs and results for its documented hindcast application. No claim is made that the model was rerun or its published calibration independently verified.
